name: trello-crm-powerup
description: Western Fabrication Ops Power-Up for Trello. Static site served by GitHub Pages; the tests here run the same files under Node.
//engines: 21, not 20: `node --test "test/*.test.js"` relies on the test runner expanding that glob itself, which landed in Node 21. The pattern is quoted so the shell does not expand it either -- on Node 20 the runner is handed the literal string, finds no such file and errors out looking like a missing test directory. CI pins 22.
